title: Tristan Harris’ Tech Nonprofit Is Laying Off Most Staff and Going ‘Founder-Led’
gist: The Center for Humane Technology is laying off about half of its 16 non-founder staff (nine departures) and ending policy research and litigation support to go 'founder-led' around Tristan Harris's public advocacy on AI risk, just after courtroom wins against social media firms. Critics argue this trades institutional teeth for celebrity and backroom influence.

insights.claim: The Center for Humane Technology is cutting about half of its 16 non-founder employees, nine departures including its executive director and senior director of strategy, and ending policy research and litigation work.
insights.speaker: Paresh Dave
insights.so_what: A key tech-accountability litigation support group is exiting courtroom work, reducing one source of legal pressure on platforms and AI labs.
